messages:
jamie: Heads up — seeing a surge of preemptions hitting mini-gang workloads in ap-southeast1-b (~09:15 UTC). ~25 tiny pods got evicted in last 5m, a bunch stuck Pending, and scheduling keeps timing out. Eviction reason shows `Preempted` + `LateBindFailure`.
sarah: saw the alert on grafana. CPU/NET looks fine, but preempt rate spiked at 09:12. Any recent scheduler changes? :eyes:
opsbot: [ALERT] cluster: ap-southeast1-b — preemptions per min = 24 (threshold 5). Related pods: mini-gang-batch/encoder-* ; firing at 09:13:02 UTC.
hugo: I rolled out a lateBind timeout tweak in the scheduler config at ~08:50 to tighten lease handoff (was 60s -> 30s). Could be causing tiny-gang handshake to fail if warm-pools are slow.
leo: @hugo can you confirm which flag? If it's `lateBind.timeoutSeconds` we might need to revert. Customers seeing retries.
hugo: yep the config patch changed `lateBindTimeoutMs: 30000`. I pushed it cluster-wide as part of pack-optimizer canary. Sorry — didn't catch mini-gang effects.
maya: customer SRE pinged — batch encoder retries are causing job backoffs and cost surge. They want ETA.
sarah: quick mitigation ideas: 1) revert lateBind timeout to 60s on ap-southeast, 2) temporarily increase preemptionBudget for tiny-gang admission so scheduler won't preempt as aggressively, 3) spin up extra warm-pool nodes in that AZ.
jamie: agreed. Which is fastest?
hugo: fastest is revert config for that region. I can patch the configmap and restart scheduler replicas. Rolling back the descheduler/optimizer changes is riskier.
jamie: do it. Include a one-line patch we can run from console.
hugo: running now — patch command: 
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"lateBindTimeoutMs":"60000"}}' && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/scheduler -n kube-system
```
deploybot: deploybot: started rollout restart for daemonset/scheduler in ap-southeast1-b at 09:22 UTC.
opsbot: [INFO] preemptions rate trending down (post-action) — 6/min at 09:28.
leo: after rollback preemptions dropped to 3/min and Pending count for mini-gang jobs halved. Still watching for 30m.
sarah: also scheduling a short descheduler job to coalesce fragmented tiny pods later today. Will follow up with config proposal.
maya: thanks — I'll update the customer (told them rollback in flight, expected stabilization).
jamie: filing a follow-up ticket to add a canary target for scheduler config changes that includes tiny-gang test jobs. Learned the hard way. :facepalm: 
opsbot: incident-note: SEV3 - mini-gang preempt surge in ap-southeast1-b — mitigated by scheduler config rollback.
leo: closing thread, will reopen if we see another spike.
